question: Can reporter-disjoint construction/direction states fitted separately in the exact M11 writer tensor H and downstream-reader tensor R be contracted to predict held-out task-functional factor responses Q?
evidence_status: Prospective CPU-only computational-structure test sealed before the managed H/R result exists. Passing is a held-out weight-tensor program screen, not a causal repair or adoption result.

searched: v17-v20 restricted weight and task-functional tensor records
v20 answer-sign, binary-factor, and factorial-prototype crossfits
M11 writer/reader atlases and current shared-subspace weight-folding plans
prior_art_and_novelty.known_lessons: The exact Q tensor has a stable additive construction-plus-direction hierarchy, but that output-level description does not establish whether writers, readers, or their positionwise interaction implement it. PCA/SAE variance and a donor-answer-signed prototype are insufficient.
prior_art_and_novelty.novelty: No receipt fits H and R independently on one reporter split and tests the literal sum_p mean(H)*mean(R) contraction on held-out reporters. This distinguishes reusable marginal states from covariance that only appears in the coupled product.

future_authority_rule: The executable must be authored only after the hash-bound managed H/R runner finishes. It must bind the resulting JSON and NPZ SHA-256 values without changing this design or any bar. Invalid or nonreconstructing H/R output closes the instrument without scoring structure.

frozen_method.reporter_folds: groups modulo 4 in {0,1} fit and {2,3} test, then reverse; four fit and four test rows per panel-by-direction cell
frozen_method.alignment: For every row, take the final L valid semantic-prefix positions, where L is the minimum valid length across all A1/A2/P rows. Padding is never data.
frozen_method.cell_states: For each fit panel-by-direction cell, compute raw arithmetic means Hbar[p,n] and Rbar[p,n] separately.
frozen_method.literal_cell_program: For every held-out row in the cell, predict Qhat[n]=sum_p Hbar[p,n]*Rbar[p,n]. Compare with exact Q[n]=sum_p H[row,p,n]*R[row,p,n]. No held-out amplitude or direction is fitted.
frozen_method.additive_states: Separately for H and R, form panel_mean + direction_mean - grand_mean, then contract the two additive state tensors identically.
frozen_method.marginal_structure: Also unit-normalize suffix-aligned flattened H and R rows and score held-out cell/additive prototype cosines. These localize stable structure but do not replace the Qhat test.
frozen_method.interaction_residual: Report Q-Qhat and the cell-program advantage over the additive program. Large residual means document-level H/R covariance or finer positionwise structure is required.

predictions.pred_a_future_authority_exact_split_alig: The managed split is valid, exactly reconstructs immutable Q, all hashes and row identities match, folds are balanced, suffix alignment excludes padding, tensors are finite, and price is exact.
predictions.pred_b_independent_cell_hr_states_predic: The literal cell program has pooled held-out Q cosine >=0.85, each of six cell means >=0.75, positive direction on all 48 rows, and pooled signed recovery in [0.50,1.50].
predictions.pred_c_additive_hr_hierarchy_is_nearly_s: The additive H/R program has pooled held-out Q cosine >=0.80 and lies no more than 0.08 cosine below the cell program.
predictions.pred_d_writer_or_reader_structure_is_rep: At least one of suffix-aligned H or R has cell-prototype pooled held-out cosine >=0.85 and cross-fold corresponding-cell prototype mean cosine >=0.90.
predictions.pred_e_scope_remains_computational_scree: No model/GPU call, v21 outcome, factor selection, dose, inference-time selector, or causal intervention is opened.

opposing_outcomes.factorized_additive_weight_state_program: A-E pass. Carry the additive H/R state interface into the sealed v21 causal implementation test.
opposing_outcomes.factorized_coupled_cell_program: A/B/D/E pass and C fails. Preserve six coupled construction-by-direction H/R states rather than an additive hierarchy.
opposing_outcomes.positionwise_or_document_covariance_requ: A/E pass but B or D fails. Do not average H and R independently; decompose the coupled positionwise product or fit a sparse/hierarchical conditional interface.
opposing_outcomes.invalid_instrument: A fails; do not score B-D.
